headword: {日本語教育|にほんごきょういく}

definitions.gloss: Japanese language education; teaching of Japanese as a foreign or second language
definitions.explanation: The field and practice of teaching the Japanese language to non-native speakers, including curriculum design, teaching methods, and related academic research.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧ (Japanese language) and ⟦{教育|きょういく}→教育：01313_kyouiku⟧ (education). Specifically refers to teaching Japanese to non-native speakers, as opposed to ⟦{国語|こくご}{教育|きょういく}→国語教育：29439_kokugokyouiku⟧ (national language education), which is Japanese language arts for native speakers in schools.

CULTURAL NOTE:
Japan passed the {日本語教育|にほんごきょういく}⟦{推進|すいしん}→推進：12908_suishin⟧⟦{法|ほう}→法：13620_hou⟧ (Japanese Language Education Promotion Act) in 2019, recognizing the government's responsibility to support Japanese language education for foreign residents. The field has grown significantly as Japan accepts more foreign workers and international students.
